When I run a Veil model within vscode I observe more concurrency (running top -o cpu in shell on the side) than when I run lake build for the same test case.

The average concurrency in vscode is about 3x but about 1.3x in the lake build within shell, case, and I observe that the improved concurrency is in the SMT part

Am I missing an argument for lake build?
